name: Akura 384 Spheroid Microplate
author: InSphero AG
notes: InSphero Akura 384 Spheroid Microplate, article CS-PC24, black-walled polystyrene bonded to a transparent 0.125 mm polystyrene membrane (refractive index 1.58), ULA coated, with lid. Every dimension is from InSphero's Technical Specifications SPEC007, October 2025 (drawing_reference), which supersedes the 2023 editions (plate height 14.80, well height 11.93, skirt 2.77, A1 to side 12.13 there). WELL SHAPE: a 3.65 x 3.65 mm square opening at the top (Figure 1B; diameter_top is its side, top_shape square) narrowing to a round 1.00 mm spheroid observation cavity with a flat optically clear base (Detail D, Figure 3; diameter, shape circle, bottom_shape flat). Height of well 11.71, plate height 14.35 (skirt 2.52 plus membrane 0.125 plus well 11.71). WALLS AND BOTTOM: black polystyrene walls (walls; no wall thickness is published) bonded to a transparent, continuous 0.125 mm polystyrene membrane of refractive index 1.58 (bottom), whose underside sits 2.52 mm above the plane the plate rests on (bottom_elevation). SKIRT: SPEC007 prints 'Skirt height: 2.52 mm' and defines it as the distance between the plate bottom and the rim (Figure 2C), the membrane's underside (Figure 5); Section A-A (Figure 2B) shows the outer wall ending in a foot at the base whose top, scaled off that low-resolution figure against the printed 14.35 mm, sits about 2.3 mm (+/-0.3) above the base, level with the membrane within what the figure resolves, so skirt_height records the printed 2.52 mm. No flange width is printed, so skirt_thickness is not recorded. CAVITY OFFSET: the cavity is not centred under the square; its centre sits 0.90 mm further from the top edge than the square's (Figure 4: 9.89 mm to the cavity centre, 8.99 mm to the square's centre). offset_from_top_edge is 9.89, the cavity centre, so the grid points at the spheroid; top_offset_from_top_edge is 8.99, the centre of the square opening 0.90 mm above it, on the standard 384-well row (top_offset_from_left_edge 12.05, the same column as the cavity). offset_from_left_edge 12.05, pitch 4.50 mm. Working volume 40-50 uL. Dimensions are in meters.
